cases.purpose: msgbox draws a bordered box centred (top row 7, left column 25 on 80x24 for a 10x30 window) with the title, wrapped text (the sentence does not fit one 30-column line) and an Ok button, in a 10x30 window.
cases.script: whiptail --title 'Wrapped' --msgbox 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and keeps on running far away' 10 30 2>res; echo "rc=$?" > rc
cases.oracle: Debian 13 whiptail 0.52.25 (newt) on the reference PATH, run in the same PTY (xterm-256color, fixed size) as the candidate whiptail builtin; screen contents decoded independently by pyte.
cases.comparison: Title, the first wrapped words, a later wrapped word and the Ok button on screen; status 0.

cases.purpose: infobox draws its text with no button and returns immediately with status 0 without waiting for a key.
cases.script: whiptail --infobox 'Please wait a moment' 6 32 2>res; echo "rc=$?" > rc
cases.oracle: Debian 13 whiptail 0.52.25 (newt) on the reference PATH, run in the same PTY (xterm-256color, fixed size) as the candidate whiptail builtin; screen contents decoded independently by pyte.
cases.comparison: Text on screen, no button, the program exits by itself with status 0. The reference whiptail 0.52.25 erases the infobox text when it exits, so no reference screen exists; asserted against the candidate as a contract.

cases.comparison: Percent text 0%, then 25%, then 75% replacing the previous value; status 0 at 100.

cases.purpose: tailbox shows the end of a file and follows lines appended while it is open: a fixture-owned background writer appends appended-w8 after 1.5 s.
cases.script:
( read -t 1.5 <> gate; echo appended-w8 >> log ) & feeder=$!
whiptail --tailbox log 12 40 2>res; echo "rc=$?" > rc
kill $feeder 2>/dev/null; wait $feeder 2>/dev/null; :
cases.oracle: The reference whiptail 0.52.25 has no --tailbox (it reports unknown option), so there is no reference executable. Expectation follows the documented tail -f style behaviour of dialog --tailbox: the display follows lines appended to the file. Screen decoded by pyte.
cases.comparison: Screen first shows only the original lines, then also shows appended-w8; status 0; the log has exactly the appended line.

cases.purpose: After the terminal shrinks from 24x80 to 14x50 while a msgbox is open, the box is redrawn consistently inside the new geometry.
cases.oracle: Debian 13 whiptail 0.52.25 (newt) on the reference PATH, run in the same PTY (xterm-256color, fixed size) as the candidate whiptail builtin; screen contents decoded independently by pyte.
cases.comparison: Before: the text row sits at row 10, column 25 (centred 8x30 window on 24x80, as the reference whiptail draws it). After the resize to 14x50 the text must be on row 5 at column 10 (centre of the new geometry); the reference whiptail redraws only on the next key, so this is asserted against the candidate as a contract.
